description: Submit a caller-confirmed appointment request for staff review. This tool does not directly confirm a booking. pending_staff_review means the request awaits staff; only committed together with booking_confirmed=true means a completed Medicus change. Technical retries must reuse the exact request_id and body.

request_body_schema.description: Use only server-issued verification and offer references from this conversation. Never send IDPAC or an agent-generated patient_verified flag. A new or changed request needs fresh caller confirmation. If the result is uncertain, preserve the request and hand off; never claim a completed booking.

request_id.description: Unique stable identifier for this logical request within the call. Reuse unchanged with identical body on technical retry; use a new value only for a new caller-confirmed request.

caller_confirmed.description: True only after the caller explicitly confirms the exact requested action and selected appointment.

patient_verification_token.description: Copy exactly from patient_lookup in this call after verification. Never invent or modify.

offer_token.description: Required for create/reschedule: copy the exact offer_token of the option confirmed by the caller. Omit for cancel.

appointment_ids.description: For cancel/reschedule: exact IDs from the verified patient appointments. Include all explicitly identified linked parts. Never infer linkage from adjacent times. Ambiguous or cross-calendar linkage requires staff.

items.description: Original appointment ID from verified lookup.
